snippet.title: Survival Curriculum
snippet.description:
Fictional Disasters. Real Science. The Survival Curriculum.

I’m Tom. I turn fictional scenarios—from zombie outbreaks to nuclear winters—into actionable, science-based survival lessons. While most channels focus on gear, we focus on the logic of collapse.

🎓 The Curriculum:

Science of Fiction: Real physics & biology applied to scenarios.

Tactical Analysis: How to survive the first 24 hours.

Real Preparedness: Actionable skills for real-world emergencies.

🤖 Production Note: This channel utilizes AI tools to assist with visualization and narration, but every single video is originally researched, scripted, directed, and manually edited by me, Tom. This is a human-led project dedicated to high-quality educational storytelling.

👇 Join the Class: Subscribe to equip yourself for the end of the world (or just your next power outage).

snippet.title: NOAA/NWS National Hurricane Center
snippet.description:
NOAA/National Weather Service
National Hurricane Center
Miami, FL

The National Weather Service (NWS) provides weather, hydrologic, and climate forecasts and warnings for the United States, its territories, adjacent waters and ocean areas, for the protection of life and property and the enhancement of the national economy. NWS data and products form a national information database and infrastructure which can be used by other governmental agencies, the private sector, the public, and the global community.

The National Hurricane Center (NHC) mission is to save lives, mitigate property loss, and improve economic efficiency by issuing the best watches, warnings, forecasts and analyses of hazardous tropical weather, and by increasing understanding of these hazards through global outreach.

snippet.title: Survival Dispatch
snippet.description:
Survival Dispatch exists for one reason: to help good people recognize danger sooner, make better decisions under stress, and get home safely.

Every week we cover the threats shaping America - from terrorism, civil unrest, border security, infrastructure failures, cyber attacks, natural disasters, economic instability, and geopolitical events - to the practical skills, mindset, and equipment needed to prepare for them.

This channel is home to:

• Survival Dispatch News (LIVE Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday & Friday at 7:00 PM ET)
• Survival Dispatch TV every Monday at 700PM ET
• JJ Morris every Saturday at 12:00 PM ET
• Product reviews some Sundays
• Special reports, expert interviews, and preparedness content throughout the week.

We don't sell fear. We teach awareness, preparedness, and practical action so you can protect yourself, your family, and your community.

If preparedness matters to you, subscribe and join us live every week.

Chris Heaven
Founder, Survival Dispatch News

snippet.title: Lady & The Owl Man
snippet.description:
We left our city lives behind and moved to the top of a mountain in Spain to live off-grid. 

Since moving here we’ve experienced some of the hottest summers in record, wildfires, floods, goats eating all of our trees, wild boar eating our vegetables and eagles eating our chickens. On top of all this we’ve been learning how to build a house for the first time on our own, in a language we have no experience in.

If you'd like to support our mission, please check us out on Patreon or Youtube members. You’ll get behind the scenes videos once per month and we’ll add your names to the credits at the end of each video ❤️.
